item.title: [Training Data] Making Cities Awesome: Peregrine’s Nick Noone & Ben Rudolph
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:40 Peregrine is really around this idea of how can we leverage technology to work with our cities, our counties, our states to to impact the the places that we live in. At the bottom of the pyramid, really, when it comes to how to make cities awesome, is the idea of safety. The idea that people need objective safety and also need to feel safe.
